title.why: The government's own English text is titled 'Artificial Intelligence Strategy', Status: November 2018.

date_published.why: 15 November 2018 is the cabinet decision date (federal government timeline) and the cover-letter date of Bundesrat paper 597/18; it is the date of adoption, which is the field's meaning.

summary_claims.claim: Three equal aims (gleichrangige Ziele): leading AI location, responsible development, embedding in society. Literal translation: 'the Federal Government sets itself the following equal-ranking goals'.
Government examines state bodies and private testing institutions to oversee algorithmic decisions; federal funding raised from three to five billion euros by the 2020 update
summary_claims.locator: p. on algorithmic decisions; bundesregierung.de notice of 2 December 2020

scope.note: Mainly an AI research, industry and skills strategy with safety content in its regulatory, standards and security sections; the existing scope_note is appropriate.

note: The Bundesrat paper 597/18 (cover letter 15 November 2018, Bundestag paper 19/5880), the English text, the 2020 update and the federal government notice of 2 December 2020 are stored; all hosts are official for DE, so the level moves from C to A by script. The run changes only the verification note. No newer strategy found in the stored files.
